verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships an official first-party MCP server (stdio) that AI tools such as Claude or Cursor run directly. This lets users operate Rollbar through natural-language prompts in those clients. The Resolve AI agent turns production errors into reviewable pull requests, but there is no evidence of a native natural-language command interface inside Rollbar itself. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command/chat interface, documentation of which operations (e.g., resolving, assigning, querying items) the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
